title: Issue with BG Trend Arrow When Using Exponential Smoothing and boradcast data to GlugoDataHandler
symptom: When the main smoothing method in AAPS is set to Exponential, GlucoDataHandler consistently shows a question mark instead of the BG trend arrow.
cause: GDH developer explained that GDH v. 2.0 automatically turns on 'Internal Trend calculation' if the received data does not contain trend info, which fixes the issue. The cause is that the received data does not contain trend info when Exponential smoothing is used.
fix: Update to GDH v. 2.0 Beta or later, which automatically turns on 'Internal Trend calculation' when received data lacks trend info. There is also a manual setting for 'Internal Trend Calculation'.
settings_changed: Internal Trend Calculation → on (automatic in GDH v2.0)
evidence_quote: GDH developer explained why GDH v. 2.0 looks like "fixing" the problem. GDH automatically turns on "Internal Trend calculation" if the received data does not contain trend info.
